_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Radicale
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A small CalDAV and CardDAV server for calendars, contacts and to-do lists, kept as plain files. Accounts are in a password file, starting with an admin account made at the first start.
startup: v=$(cat .radicale-version); h=$( (python3 --version; echo "$v") | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat .venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Radicale $v"; rm -rf .venv; python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check "radicale[bcrypt]==$v" && echo "$h" > .venv/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f .raptor-admin ]; then pw="{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}"; if [ -z "$pw" ]; then (umask 077; head -c 18 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d "\n/+=" > admin-password.txt); pw=$(cat admin-password.txt); echo "Admin password is empty, so the account {{ADMIN_USER}} has the password in admin-password.txt."; fi; RU="{{ADMIN_USER}}" RP="$pw" .venv/bin/python -c 'import bcrypt, os, sys; u, p = os.environ["RU"], os.environ["RP"]; lines = open("users").read().splitlines(); sys.exit(0) if any(l.split(":", 1)[0] == u for l in lines) else open("users", "a").write(u + ":" + bcrypt.hashpw(p.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode() + "\n")' && touch .raptor-admin || exit 1; fi; exec .venv/bin/python -m radicale --config config

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Radicale: picks the chosen Radicale version from PyPI and writes a first
# configuration. Radicale itself is installed from PyPI when the server
# starts, for the Python version it runs. The settings (config), the users
# file and the calendars and address books (collections/) are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
json=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://pypi.org/pypi/radicale/json) || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    version=$(jq -r .info.version <<<"$json")
else
    version="${want#v}"
    jq -e --arg v "$version" '.releases[$v] | length > 0' <<<"$json" >/dev/null ||
        fail "Radicale has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 3.9.1, then reinstall."
    case "$version" in 3.*) ;; *) fail "This egg runs Radicale 3 only. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 3.9.1." ;; esac
fi
echo "$version" > .radicale-version

mkdir -p collections
[ -f users ] || { touch users; chmod 600 users; }
if [ ! -f config ]; then
    cat > config <<'CONF'
# Radicale's settings: https://radicale.org/v3.html#configuration
[server]
# Raptor sets this to the server's port at every start.
hosts = 0.0.0.0:5232

[auth]
# Accounts are in the users file, one "name:bcrypt hash" per line. Raptor
# adds the admin account from the server's settings at the first start.
type = htpasswd
htpasswd_filename = /home/container/users
htpasswd_encryption = autodetect
# Wait a little after a wrong password, to slow down guessing.
delay = 2

[rights]
# Each user sees only their own calendars and address books.
type = owner_only

[storage]
filesystem_folder = /home/container/collections

[logging]
level = info
CONF
    echo "Wrote a first config."
fi
echo "Selected Radicale $version (it's installed from PyPI when the server starts)."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Radicale version to install, such as 3.9.1, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The first account's username, made at the first start. Add more accounts to the users file.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The first account's password, used only at the first start. Leave it empty to use a random one, saved in admin-password.txt.
